arxiv-1512-05433.description: Abstract Optical resonance is central to a wide range of optical devices and techniques. In an optical cavity, the round-trip length and mirror reflectivity can be chosen to optimize the circulating optical power, linewidth, and free-spectral range (FSR) for a given application.

arxiv-2109-11547.title: Bayesian Active Learning for Sim-to-Real Robotic Perception
arxiv-2109-11547.creator: Jianxiang Feng, Jongseok Lee, Maximilian Durner, Rudolph Triebel
arxiv-2109-11547.description: Abstract While learning from synthetic training data has recently gained an increased attention, in real-world robotic applications, there are still performance deficiencies due to the so-called Sim-to-Real gap. In practice, this gap is hard to resolve with only synthetic data. Therefore, we focus on an efficient acquisition of real data within a Sim-to-Real learning pipeline.

arxiv-2212-03374.title: Learning State Transition Rules from Hidden Layers of Restricted Boltzmann Machines
arxiv-2212-03374.creator: Koji Watanabe, Katsumi Inoue
arxiv-2212-03374.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Koji Watanabe, Katsumi Inoue. Understanding the dynamics of a system is important in many scientific and engineering domains. This problem can be approached by learning state transition rules from observations using machine learning techniques. Such observed time-series data often consist of sequences of many continuous variables with noise and ambiguity, but we often need rules of dynamics that can be modeled with a few essential variables.

arxiv-2302-12543.title: Stiff connections in pseudo-Euclidean manifolds
arxiv-2302-12543.creator: Arnaud Chéritat, Guillaume Tahar
arxiv-2302-12543.description: Abstract . For a smooth manifold endowed with a (similarity) pseudo-Euclidean structure, a stiff connection ∇ \nabla is a symmetric affine connection such that geodesics of ∇ \nabla are straight lines of the pseudo-Euclidean structure while the first-order infinitesimal holonomy at each point is an infinitesimal isometry.

arxiv-2307-13754.creator: Francisco Maion, Raul E. Angulo, Thomas Bakx, Nora Elisa Chisari, Toshiki Kurita, Marcos Pellejero-Ibañez
arxiv-2307-13754.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Francisco Maion, Raul E. Angulo, Thomas Bakx, Nora Elisa Chisari, Toshiki Kurita, Marcos Pellejero-Ibañez. The intrinsic alignment of galaxies is an important ingredient for modelling weak-lensing measurements, and a potentially valuable cosmological and astrophysical signal. In this paper, we present HYMALAIA: a new model to predict the intrinsic alignments of biased tracers.

arxiv-2312-11516.title: Essay: Where Can Quantum Geometry Lead Us?
arxiv-2312-11516.creator: Päivi Törmä
arxiv-2312-11516.description: Abstract Quantum geometry defines the phase and amplitude distances between quantum states. The phase distance is characterized by the Berry curvature and thus relates to topological phenomena. The significance of the full quantum geometry, including the amplitude distance characterized by the quantum metric, has started to receive attention in the last few years.

arxiv-2408-12106.title: RIS-Vis: A Novel Visualization Platform for Seismic, Geodetic, and Weather Data Relevant to Antarctic Cryosphere Science
arxiv-2408-12106.creator: Aishwarya Chakravarthy, Dhiman Mondal, John Barrett, Chet Ruszczyk, Pedro Elosegui
arxiv-2408-12106.description: Abstract Antarctic ice shelves play a vital role in preserving the health of the Antarctic cryosphere and beyond. By serving as a buttressing force, ice shelves prevent sea-level rise by restraining the flow of continental ice and glaciers to sea. Sea-level rise impacts the global environment in multiple ways, including flooding habitats, eroding coastlines, and contaminating groundwater.

arxiv-2502-07169.title: Advancing Geological Carbon Storage Monitoring with 3D Digital Shadow Technology
arxiv-2502-07169.creator: Abhinav Prakash Gahlot
arxiv-2502-07169.description: Abstract 1 Introduction To limit global warming and achieve climate goals, the IPCC highlights the need for technologies capable of removing gigatonnes of CO 2 annually (IPCC, Panel on Climate Change) (2018)), with Geological Carbon Storage (GCS) playing a key role in this effort. GCS captures CO 2 emissions and stores them in deep geological formations.

arxiv-2510-01694.title: First Passage Times to T cell activation
arxiv-2510-01694.creator: Tony Wong, Ikchang Cho, Maria R. D’Orsogna, Tom Chou ()
arxiv-2510-01694.description: Abstract Effective recognition of foreign antigens by the adaptive immune system relies on T cells being activated by antigen-presenting cells (APCs) in lymph nodes. Here, diffusing T cells may encounter cognate APCs that present matching antigen fragments or non-cognate ones that do not; they are also subject to degradation.

pmc-10606440.creator: Pedro A V Freitas, Laia Martín-Pérez, Irene Gil-Guillén, Chelo González-Martínez, Amparo Chiralt, Mario M Martinez, Sílvia Petronilho
pmc-10606440.description: Almond skin (AS) is an agro-industrial residue from almond processing that has a high potential for valorisation. In this study, subcritical water extraction (SWE) was applied at two temperatures (160 and 180 °C) to obtain phenolic-rich extracts (water-soluble fraction) and cellulose fibres (insoluble fraction) from AS. The extraction conditions affected the composition and properties of both valorised fractions.

pmc-12727934.title: The effects of transcranial direct current stimulation on EEG power and complexity of ischemic stroke
pmc-12727934.creator: Wang Xi, Guoqiang Song, Zhizhao Ma, Liqiang Liu
pmc-12727934.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS), has shown therapeutic potential for ischemic stroke, but the neural oscillatory mechanisms of its therapeutic effects remain incompletely elucidated. Based on the rat model and clinical stroke patients, this paper combines multiple indicators such as electroencephalography (EEG) relative power (RP), Lempel-Ziv complexity and sample entropy to investigate the mechanism by which tDCS modulates neural oscillations in ischemic stroke.

pmc-12784700.title: Impact of Dietary Protein Levels and Gender on Carcass Characteristics and Meat Quality in Slow-Growing Ducks
pmc-12784700.creator: Yong Jiang, Yijia Lu, Zhong Zhuang, Lei Wu, Yongpeng Li, Hao Bai, Yulin Bi, Zhixiu Wang, Shihao Chen, Guobin Chang
pmc-12784700.description: Simple SummaryFast-growing ducks dominate meat duck production, but the associated high-density feeding leads to reduced meat quality and flavor. Slow-growing ducks with high levels of muscle fat, unsaturated fatty acids, and flavor compounds have better meat quality and are in greater demand.

pmc-13091180.title: Metformin alleviates aging-associated periodontitis via NRF2-mediated restoration of the IRE1α dependent unfolded protein response
pmc-13091180.creator: Yu Sun, Qifeng Chen, Yan Zhao, Yuanyuan Yin, Qiao Chen, Lixin Yang, Zixuan Liu, Rui Chen, Xiaohui Xu, Jinlin Song
pmc-13091180.description: Proteostasis disruption due to impaired unfolded protein response (UPR) is a hallmark of aging and contributes largely to cellular dysfunction, but its role and associated mechanisms in aging-associated periodontitis remain unclear. This study reveals that senescent periodontal ligament stem cells (PDLSCs) exhibit impaired NRF2/IRE1α-dependent UPR signaling, leading to increased senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) and reduced osteogenesis.

Universal radical cure, which administers hypnozoite-targeting treatment to patients with P. falciparum malaria living in co-endemic areas, has potential to reduce P. vivax relapses.

pmc-13609640.creator: Binbin Jiang, Xiying Chen, Xu He, Yunlong Chai, Yan Wang, Ranhong Li
